blocks.text: After creating playbooks, you can manage playbooks to refine how actions are taken.
When managing playbooks, you can perform the following actions:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Agentic SOC or Identities.
In the left-side navigation, go to Automations > Playbooks.
The Playbooks page appears.
Hover over the playbook you want to edit, and click the Edit icon.
See image.
The Edit Playbook page appears.
Make the necessary changes.
Click Save.

blocks.text: Deleting a playbook doesn't trigger a warning message and deletes the playbook immediately.

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Agentic SOC or Identities.
In the left-side navigation, go to Automations > Playbooks.
The Playbooks page appears.
Hover over the playbook you want to delete, and click the Delete icon.
See image.
In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Agentic SOC or Identities.
In the left-side navigation, go to Automations > Playbooks.
The Playbooks page appears.
Hover over the playbook you want to view runs for, and click the See Runs icon.
See image.
The playbook's Runs page appears.
View details of the playbook runs. You can sort each column. For each run, you can see:
Status: The outcome of each run:
Completed: The run successfully completed without issues.
Canceled: The run was intentionally stopped by the user.
Failed: The run encountered an error and did not complete successfully.
Entity Type: The entity the playbook affected.
Entity URL: Click the link to view the entity.
Triggering Type: Indicates how the run was triggered:
Manual: A run manually initiated by a user.
Automatic: A run initiated by an automation rule.
Triggered By: Displays who initiated the run:
System: The run was triggered by an automation rule when the conditions for the playbook were met.
User: The run was triggered by a user clicking Process or Process All.
Execution Time and Completed At: The timestamps when the run started and ended. This information can reveal potential issues with the run.
Total Time: The total amount of time the run took to complete.
See image.
Click to expand a run. For each action, you can see:
Action Name: The name of the action.
Status: The outcome of each action:
Completed: The action successfully completed without issues.
Failed: The action encountered an error and did not complete successfully.
Reason: The reason the action failed.
Start Time and End Time: The timestamps when the action started and ended.
Total Time: The total amount of time the action took to complete.
Payload: The JSON payload of the action.
See image.

blocks.text: You can export playbooks to share them between your accounts.

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Agentic SOC or Identities.
In the left-side navigation, go to Automations > Playbooks.
The Playbooks page appears.
Export a playbook in one of the following ways:
On the Playbooks page, hover over the playbook you want to export, and click the Export icon.
See image.
On the Edit Playbook page, click More > Export Playbook.
See image.

blocks.text: To import a playbook's JSON file into an existing playbook:
Importing a playbook into an existing playbook will overwrite it. If you want to preserve the existing playbook, you can create a new playbook from a JSON file.

blocks.item: Click the existing playbook you want to overwrite.
The Edit Playbook page appears.
On the Edit Playbook page, click More > Import from JSON.
See image.
Locate the JSON file in your local folder, then click Open.
The newly imported playbook overwrites the existing playbook.
Click Save.
In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Agentic SOC or Identities.
In the left-side navigation, go to Automations > Playbooks.
The Playbooks page appears.
Hover over the playbook you want to duplicate, and click the Duplicate icon.
See image.
A copy of the rule is created with the same name as the original and Copy appended to the end.
In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Agentic SOC or Identities.
In the left-side navigation, go to Automations > Playbooks.
The Playbooks page appears.
Click the playbook that you want to view logs for.
The Edit Playbook page appears.
On the Edit Playbook page, click More > Audit Logs.
See image.
The playbook's Audit Logs page appears.
Review the playbook's audit logs. You can sort each column. For each log, you can see:
Time: The time the action occurred.
Operation: The type of operation made.
Type: The entity the playbook affects.
User Name: The user who made the changes.
Click to expand a log, and view the playbook differences in JSON.
See image.
(Optional) Click the Download icon to download all audit logs in the current list from the last 90 days.
See image.
